metadata.title: Cobordism maps and Atiyah-Floer isomorphisms for framed instanton homology I
metadata.abstract: We prove that isomorphisms of the type constructed by Daemi, Fukaya and Lipyanskiy, between framed instanton homology and the Lagrangian Floer homology of a Heegaard splitting, intertwine the cobordism maps of Kronheimer and Mrowka with maps defined by holomorphic curves alone, over the field of two elements. This holds for every connected cobordism between connected three-manifolds carrying a framed arc between its ends and an $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ bundle trivialized along the ends and the arc. The symplectic maps count holomorphic triangles in moduli spaces of flat connections on surfaces, with the correspondence of a compression body as boundary condition for one- and three-handles. Consequently these maps are independent of the handle decomposition and of the Heegaard data, and form a functor isomorphic to framed instanton homology; where both are defined, our isomorphisms agree with those of Daemi, Fukaya and Lipyanskiy modulo two. The proof rests on two analytic results for the mixed anti-self-duality and holomorphic curve equation: an adiabatic limit in which a compression body collapses next to a holomorphic strip and becomes the Lagrangian boundary condition of its flat connections, and an excision theorem along a torus.

analysis.workSummary: 作者证明带标架瞬子同调与Heegaard Lagrangian Floer同调的Atiyah–Floer型同构，在模2系数下交织配边映射，辛侧只计全纯曲线。
techniques: 把柄分解及全纯三角形
analysis.breakthrough: 对两端连通三流形间带标架弧且SO(3)丛沿端点及弧平凡化的连通配边，构成同构函子，并得到把柄与Heegaard数据独立性。
analysis.limitations: 系数域为F₂，丛及配边装饰是条件。156页分析中的绝热极限与切除输入尚未审读，不能扩大为所有Atiyah–Floer版本。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
